数据分析报告——在GSE37642数据集中基于基因表达的急性髓系白血病（AML）患者预后预测模型¶

1.数据读取¶

1.1 检测项目环境¶

In [1]:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import requests
import gzip
import re
from pathlib import Path

print("AML 预后预测项目环境检查成功！")
print("Pandas 版本：", pd.__version__)
print("NumPy 版本：", np.__version__)

1.2 设置项目保存路径和原始数据访问途径¶

In [2]:
# 创建项目文件夹
BASE_DIR = Path.home() / "Desktop" / "AML_Prognosis"
RAW_DIR = BASE_DIR / "data" / "raw"
PROCESSED_DIR = BASE_DIR / "data" / "processed"
RESULTS_DIR = BASE_DIR / "results"

for folder in [RAW_DIR, PROCESSED_DIR, RESULTS_DIR]:
    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

print("项目目录：", BASE_DIR)
print("原始数据目录：", RAW_DIR)

# 检查是否能访问 GEO 官方网站
url = "https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE37nnn/GSE37642/"

try:
    response = requests.get(url, timeout=30)
    print("GEO HTTP 状态码：", response.status_code)
    print("是否成功访问：", response.ok)
except requests.RequestException as e:
    print("访问 GEO 失败：", repr(e))

#由于文件可能由字符编码编码，所以我们需要先检查项目原始数据编码方式
save_path = (
    Path.home()
    / "Desktop"
    / "AML_Prognosis"
    / "data"
    / "raw"
    / "GSE37642_Survival_data.txt.gz"
)

# 先用二进制方式读取，避免编码错误
with gzip.open(save_path, "rb") as f:
    content = f.read()

print("解压后的文件大小：", len(content), "bytes")
print("文件开头的原始字节：")
print(repr(content[:500]))

# 尝试几种常见编码
for encoding in ["utf-8", "cp1252", "latin1"]:
    try:
        text = content.decode(encoding)
        print(f"\n成功使用编码：{encoding}")
        print("文件前 15 行：")
        for i, line in enumerate(text.splitlines()[:15], start=1):
            print(f"{i}: {line}")
        break
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        print(f"{encoding} 解码失败")

1.3 读取并初步检查生存数据¶

In [4]:
#整理并检查全部患者数据
save_path = (
    Path.home()
    / "Desktop"
    / "AML_Prognosis"
    / "data"
    / "raw"
    / "GSE37642_Survival_data.txt.gz"
)

# 读取真实文件：注意使用 cp1252 编码
with gzip.open(save_path, "rt", encoding="cp1252") as f:
    survival_df = pd.read_csv(f, sep="\t")

# 去除列名首尾空格
survival_df.columns = survival_df.columns.str.strip()

# 检查数据
print("数据维度（行数，列数）：", survival_df.shape)
print("\n列名：")
print(survival_df.columns.tolist())

print("\n前 10 行：")
display(survival_df.head(10))

print("\n各列缺失值数量：")
print(survival_df.isna().sum())

print("\nSAMPLE 重复数量：")
print(survival_df["SAMPLE"].duplicated().sum())

print("\n生存结局分布：")
print(survival_df["life status"].value_counts(dropna=False))

print("\n生存时间基本统计：")
print(
    pd.to_numeric(
        survival_df["overall survival (days)"],
        errors="coerce"
    ).describe()
)

# 保存整理后的临床数据
processed_dir = (
    Path.home()
    / "Desktop"
    / "AML_Prognosis"
    / "data"
    / "processed"
)
processed_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

output_path = processed_dir / "GSE37642_survival_cleaned.csv"
survival_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")

print("\n整理后的数据已保存到：")
print(output_path)

1.4 检查GEO数据表达文件清单¶

In [5]:
BASE_DIR = Path.home() / "Desktop" / "AML_Prognosis"
RAW_DIR = BASE_DIR / "data" / "raw"
RAW_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

url = (
    "https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/"
    "GSE37nnn/GSE37642/suppl/filelist.txt"
)
file_path = RAW_DIR / "GSE37642_filelist.txt"

response = requests.get(url, timeout=60)
response.raise_for_status()
file_path.write_bytes(response.content)

# 该文件可能包含非 UTF-8 字符，因此用容错方式查看
text = response.content.decode("latin1")
lines = text.splitlines()

print("文件清单总行数：", len(lines))
print("\n前 30 行：")
for i, line in enumerate(lines[:30], start=1):
    print(f"{i}: {line}")

# 查看清单里是否提到已知样本编号
print("\n检查生存表中的前几个样本编号：")
for gsm in ["GSM923596", "GSM923597", "GSM923598"]:
    hits = [line for line in lines if gsm in line]
    print(gsm, "匹配行数：", len(hits))
    for line in hits[:3]:
        print(" ", line)

GSE37642 的补充文件清单列出的是每个样本的 CEL 芯片原始数据，而不是已经整理好的基因表达矩阵。¶

  • filelist.txt 有 986 行
  • 后面有 GSM923596、GSM923597、GSM923598 等样本对应的 .CEL.gz 文件
  • 这些文件是 Affymetrix 芯片的原始数据，后续需要经过标准化处理，才能构建基因表达矩阵

1.5 查找并读取 GEO 处理后的表达矩阵¶

In [6]:
from html.parser import HTMLParser

base_dir = Path.home() / "Desktop" / "AML_Prognosis"
raw_dir = base_dir / "data" / "raw"
raw_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

base_url = (
    "https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/"
    "GSE37nnn/GSE37642/matrix/"
)

files = [
    "GSE37642-GPL570_series_matrix.txt.gz",
    "GSE37642-GPL96_series_matrix.txt.gz",
    "GSE37642-GPL97_series_matrix.txt.gz",
]

matrix_info = {}

for filename in files:
    save_path = raw_dir / filename
    url = base_url + filename

    # 文件不存在时才下载
    if not save_path.exists():
        print("\n正在下载：", filename)
        response = requests.get(url, timeout=180)
        response.raise_for_status()
        save_path.write_bytes(response.content)
    else:
        print("\n本地已存在：", filename)

    print("文件大小：", round(save_path.stat().st_size / 1024**2, 2), "MB")

    # 读取矩阵的样本元信息，不把整个表达表载入内存
    metadata = {}
    with gzip.open(save_path, "rt", encoding="latin1") as f:
        for line in f:
            if line.startswith("!Sample_geo_accession"):
                metadata["GSM"] = re.findall(r'"(GSM\d+)"', line)
            elif line.startswith("!Sample_title"):
                metadata["titles"] = re.findall(r'"([^"]*)"', line)
            elif line.startswith("!Sample_platform_id"):
                metadata["platforms"] = re.findall(r'"([^"]*)"', line)
            elif line.startswith("!series_matrix_table_begin"):
                break

    gsm_list = metadata.get("GSM", [])
    matrix_info[filename] = gsm_list

    print("识别到的 GSM 样本数：", len(gsm_list))
    print("前 5 个 GSM 编号：", gsm_list[:5])
    print("平台信息：", metadata.get("platforms", []))

print("\n检查结束。")

2. 数据预处理¶

2.1 核对样本编号¶

In [7]:
base_dir = Path.home() / "Desktop" / "AML_Prognosis"
raw_dir = base_dir / "data" / "raw"
processed_dir = base_dir / "data" / "processed"

# 读取已经保存的生存表和文件清单
survival_df = pd.read_csv(
    processed_dir / "GSE37642_survival_cleaned.csv"
)

filelist_path = raw_dir / "GSE37642_filelist.txt"
with open(filelist_path, "r", encoding="latin1") as f:
    filelist_lines = f.readlines()

# 从文件清单中提取所有 GSM 编号
gsm_in_files = set()
for line in filelist_lines:
    gsm_in_files.update(re.findall(r"GSM\d+", line))

# 生存表中的样本编号
gsm_in_survival = set(
    survival_df["SAMPLE"].dropna().astype(str).str.strip()
)

matched = sorted(gsm_in_survival & gsm_in_files)
only_survival = sorted(gsm_in_survival - gsm_in_files)
only_filelist = sorted(gsm_in_files - gsm_in_survival)

print("生存表记录数：", len(survival_df))
print("生存表中不同 GSM 编号数：", len(gsm_in_survival))
print("文件清单中不同 GSM 编号数：", len(gsm_in_files))
print("两边成功匹配的 GSM 编号数：", len(matched))
print("只在生存表中的编号数：", len(only_survival))
print("只在文件清单中的编号数：", len(only_filelist))

print("\n匹配成功的前 10 个编号：")
print(matched[:10])

print("\n仅在生存表中的前 10 个编号：")
print(only_survival[:10])

# 保存匹配结果，供下一步检查
match_df = survival_df[
    survival_df["SAMPLE"].astype(str).str.strip().isin(matched)
].copy()

match_df.to_csv(
    processed_dir / "GSE37642_matched_survival.csv",
    index=False,
    encoding="utf-8-sig"
)

print("\n匹配后的生存表已保存。")

2.3 核实GPL96其标准化方法和探针注释信息¶

In [9]:
# 1. 设置文件路径
base_dir = Path.home() / "Desktop" / "AML_Prognosis"
raw_dir = base_dir / "data" / "raw"
processed_dir = base_dir / "data" / "processed"
processed_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

matrix_path = raw_dir / "GSE37642-GPL96_series_matrix.txt.gz"
survival_path = processed_dir / "GSE37642_survival_cleaned.csv"

# 2. 找到表达矩阵正式数据表的起始位置
with gzip.open(matrix_path, "rt", encoding="latin1") as f:
    for line in f:
        if line.startswith("!series_matrix_table_begin"):
            break

    # 3. 读取表达矩阵
    expression_df = pd.read_csv(
        f,
        sep="\t",
        index_col=0,
        na_values=["null", "NA", ""],
        on_bad_lines="error"
    )

# 去掉可能残留的引号
expression_df.index = (
    expression_df.index.astype(str).str.strip('"')
)
expression_df.columns = (
    expression_df.columns.astype(str).str.strip('"')
)

print("表达矩阵维度（探针数，样本数）：", expression_df.shape)
print("探针编号示例：", expression_df.index[:5].tolist())
print("样本编号示例：", expression_df.columns[:5].tolist())
print("表达矩阵缺失值总数：", expression_df.isna().sum().sum())

# 4. 读取生存数据
survival_df = pd.read_csv(survival_path)
survival_df["SAMPLE"] = survival_df["SAMPLE"].astype(str).str.strip()

# 5. 计算双方共同样本
common_samples = [
    sample for sample in expression_df.columns
    if sample in set(survival_df["SAMPLE"])
]

print("\n表达矩阵与生存表共同样本数：", len(common_samples))

# 6. 按共同样本提取表达值和生存记录
expression_matched = expression_df[common_samples].copy()

survival_matched = (
    survival_df.set_index("SAMPLE")
    .loc[common_samples]
    .reset_index()
)

print("匹配后表达矩阵维度：", expression_matched.shape)
print("匹配后生存表维度：", survival_matched.shape)

# 7. 保存匹配后的数据
expression_matched.to_csv(
    processed_dir / "GSE37642_GPL96_expression_matched.csv",
    encoding="utf-8-sig"
)

survival_matched.to_csv(
    processed_dir / "GSE37642_GPL96_survival_matched.csv",
    index=False,
    encoding="utf-8-sig"
)

print("\n匹配后的表达矩阵和生存表已保存到：")
print(processed_dir)

  • 当前的匹配结果是 GPL96 平台的数据，还不是最终可用于建模的数据集。 下一步先处理缺失值和生存结局。

2.4 定位 422 个缺失值¶

In [10]:
base_dir = Path.home() / "Desktop" / "AML_Prognosis"
processed_dir = base_dir / "data" / "processed"

expr_path = processed_dir / "GSE37642_GPL96_expression_matched.csv"
surv_path = processed_dir / "GSE37642_GPL96_survival_matched.csv"

expr = pd.read_csv(expr_path, index_col=0)
surv = pd.read_csv(surv_path)

print("一、表达矩阵缺失值检查")
print("总缺失值数：", int(expr.isna().sum().sum()))
print("存在缺失值的探针数：", int(expr.isna().any(axis=1).sum()))
print("存在缺失值的样本数：", int(expr.isna().any(axis=0).sum()))

missing_rows = expr.index[expr.isna().any(axis=1)].tolist()
missing_cols = expr.columns[expr.isna().any(axis=0)].tolist()

print("有缺失值的探针示例：", missing_rows[:10])
print("有缺失值的样本示例：", missing_cols[:10])

print("\n二、生存数据字段")
print(surv.columns.tolist())

time_col = "overall survival (days)"
status_col = "life status"

surv[time_col] = pd.to_numeric(surv[time_col], errors="coerce")

print("\n生存时间缺失数：", int(surv[time_col].isna().sum()))
print("生存时间小于或等于 0 的记录数：",
      int((surv[time_col].notna() & (surv[time_col] <= 0)).sum()))

print("\n结局状态分布：")
print(surv[status_col].value_counts(dropna=False))

print("\n三、检查完成")

2.5 修正表达矩阵¶

In [11]:
# 1. 设置文件路径

2.7 生成清洗后的生存分析数据集¶

In [13]:
# 1. 设置路径
base_dir = Path.home() / "Desktop" / "AML_Prognosis"
processed_dir = base_dir / "data" / "processed"

surv_path = processed_dir / "GSE37642_GPL96_survival_matched.csv"
expr_path = processed_dir / "GSE37642_GPL96_expression_cleaned.csv"

# 2. 读取数据
surv = pd.read_csv(surv_path)
expr = pd.read_csv(expr_path, index_col=0)

time_col = "overall survival (days)"
status_col = "life status"

# 3. 整理生存时间与结局状态
surv[time_col] = pd.to_numeric(surv[time_col], errors="coerce")
surv[status_col] = surv[status_col].astype("string").str.strip().str.lower()

# 4. 仅保留生存时间有效、结局状态明确的患者
valid_mask = (
    surv[time_col].notna()
    & (surv[time_col] > 0)
    & surv[status_col].isin(["dead", "alive"])
)

surv_clean = surv.loc[valid_mask].copy()

# 5. 编码生存结局：死亡=1，存活删失=0
surv_clean["event"] = surv_clean[status_col].map({
    "dead": 1,
    "alive": 0
}).astype(int)

# 6. 检查样本编号是否重复
print("清洗后患者数：", len(surv_clean))
print("重复样本编号数：", int(surv_clean["SAMPLE"].duplicated().sum()))
print("重复患者编号数：", int(surv_clean["GEO_ID"].duplicated().sum()))
print("\n死亡/删失分布：")
print(surv_clean["event"].value_counts().sort_index().rename(index={
    0: "存活（删失）",
    1: "死亡事件"
}))

# 7. 检查生存样本是否都存在于表达矩阵
expr_samples = set(expr.columns)
surv_samples = set(surv_clean["SAMPLE"].astype(str))

print("\n生存数据中存在于表达矩阵的样本数：",
      len(surv_samples & expr_samples))
print("生存数据中未匹配到表达矩阵的样本数：",
      len(surv_samples - expr_samples))

# 8. 保存清洗后的生存数据
out_path = processed_dir / "GSE37642_survival_analysis_ready.csv"
surv_clean.to_csv(out_path, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")

print("\n清洗后的生存数据已保存至：")
print(out_path)

2.8 读取清洗后 GPL96 芯片注释文件¶

In [14]:
import GEOparse

# 1. 设置项目路径
base_dir = Path.home() / "Desktop" / "AML_Prognosis"
processed_dir = base_dir / "data" / "processed"
raw_dir = base_dir / "data" / "raw"

# 2. 读取已经清洗的表达矩阵
expr = pd.read_csv(
    processed_dir / "GSE37642_GPL96_expression_cleaned.csv",
    index_col=0
)

# 3. 使用 GEOparse 读取本地 GPL96 注释文件
gpl = GEOparse.get_GEO(
    "GPL96",
    destdir=str(raw_dir),
    how="full"
)

annotation = gpl.table.copy()

# 4. 整理探针编号和注释字段
expr.index = expr.index.astype(str).str.strip()
annotation["ID"] = annotation["ID"].astype(str).str.strip()

anno = annotation[
    ["ID", "Gene Symbol", "ENTREZ_GENE_ID"]
].copy()

anno = anno.drop_duplicates(subset="ID")

# 5. 将表达矩阵中的探针与注释表匹配
probe_table = pd.DataFrame({"ID": expr.index})

probe_table = probe_table.merge(
    anno,
    on="ID",
    how="left",
    validate="one_to_one"
)

# 6. 统计注释情况
gene_symbol = (
    probe_table["Gene Symbol"]
    .fillna("")
    .astype(str)
    .str.strip()
)

valid_symbol = (
    gene_symbol.ne("")
    & gene_symbol.str.lower().ne("nan")
    & gene_symbol.ne("---")
)

print("表达矩阵探针数：", len(expr.index))
print("GPL96 注释记录数：", len(annotation))
print(
    "成功匹配注释记录数：",
    int(probe_table["Gene Symbol"].notna().sum())
)
print("具有非空基因符号的探针数：", int(valid_symbol.sum()))
print("缺少有效基因符号的探针数：", int((~valid_symbol).sum()))

print("\n前 10 条注释结果：")
display(probe_table.head(10))

# 7. 保存注释表
anno_path = processed_dir / "GSE37642_GPL96_probe_annotation.csv"

probe_table.to_csv(
    anno_path,
    index=False,
    encoding="utf-8-sig"
)

print("\n注释结果保存位置：")
print(anno_path)

2.9 探针注释与数据清理¶

In [15]:
#表达矩阵探针数与GPL96 注释记录数不一致，需要检查注释是否存在一对多、多对一关系
base_dir = Path.home() / "Desktop" / "AML_Prognosis"
processed_dir = base_dir / "data" / "processed"

# 读取刚刚保存的探针注释表
probe_table = pd.read_csv(
    processed_dir / "GSE37642_GPL96_probe_annotation.csv",
    dtype=str
)

# 清理基因符号
symbols = (
    probe_table["Gene Symbol"]
    .fillna("")
    .astype(str)
    .str.strip()
)

# 判断是否有多个基因符号
has_multiple = symbols.str.contains(r"\s*///\s*", regex=True)

# 统计单基因注释和多基因注释
valid = (
    symbols.ne("")
    & symbols.str.lower().ne("nan")
    & symbols.ne("---")
)

print("注释表探针总数：", len(probe_table))
print("具有有效基因符号的探针数：", int(valid.sum()))
print("含多个基因符号的探针数：", int((valid & has_multiple).sum()))
print("仅含单个基因符号的探针数：", int((valid & ~has_multiple).sum()))

print("\n多基因注释示例：")
display(
    probe_table.loc[
        valid & has_multiple,
        ["ID", "Gene Symbol", "ENTREZ_GENE_ID"]
    ].head(15)
)

# 检查同一个基因符号是否对应多个探针
single_gene = probe_table.loc[
    valid & ~has_multiple,
    ["ID", "Gene Symbol"]
].copy()

single_gene["Gene Symbol"] = (
    single_gene["Gene Symbol"].str.strip()
)

probe_counts = single_gene.groupby("Gene Symbol")["ID"].nunique()

print("\n单基因注释涉及的不同基因数：", len(probe_counts))
print("对应多个探针的基因数：", int((probe_counts > 1).sum()))

print("\n对应探针最多的前 10 个基因：")
display(
    probe_counts.sort_values(ascending=False).head(10).to_frame(
        "Number_of_probes"
    )
)

两个重要结论：

  1. 探针不等于基因。 例如 HFE 有 13 个探针，不能直接将它们当成 13 个独立基因。
  2. 多基因注释需要谨慎处理。 例如 DDR1 /// MIR4640 无法仅凭这个字符串确定探针信号究竟来自哪个基因，因此不建议直接拆分后复制表达值。

2.10 生成基因水平的表达矩阵¶

In [16]:
# 1. 设置路径
base_dir = Path.home() / "Desktop" / "AML_Prognosis"
processed_dir = base_dir / "data" / "processed"

# 2. 读取患者水平的表达矩阵（417例患者 × 探针）
expr = pd.read_csv(
    processed_dir / "GSE37642_GPL96_model_expression.csv",
    index_col=0
)

# 3. 读取探针注释表
anno = pd.read_csv(
    processed_dir / "GSE37642_GPL96_probe_annotation.csv",
    dtype=str
)

anno["ID"] = anno["ID"].astype(str).str.strip()
anno["Gene Symbol"] = (
    anno["Gene Symbol"].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip()
)

# 4. 仅保留有效的单基因注释
symbols = anno["Gene Symbol"]

valid = (
    symbols.ne("")
    & symbols.str.lower().ne("nan")
    & symbols.ne("---")
    & ~symbols.str.contains(r"\s*///\s*", regex=True)
)

anno_single = anno.loc[valid, ["ID", "Gene Symbol"]].copy()

# 5. 只保留表达矩阵中确实存在的探针
anno_single = anno_single[
    anno_single["ID"].isin(expr.columns)
].copy()

# 6. 计算每个探针在417例患者中的表达方差
probe_variance = expr.var(axis=0)

anno_single["variance"] = anno_single["ID"].map(probe_variance)
anno_single = anno_single.dropna(subset=["variance"])

# 7. 每个基因选择表达方差最大的一个探针
anno_single = anno_single.sort_values(
    "variance", ascending=False
)

gene_map = anno_single.drop_duplicates(
    subset="Gene Symbol",
    keep="first"
).copy()

# 8. 构建基因水平表达矩阵
selected_probes = gene_map["ID"].tolist()
selected_genes = gene_map["Gene Symbol"].tolist()

gene_expr = expr[selected_probes].copy()
gene_expr.columns = selected_genes

# 9. 检查矩阵
print("患者数：", gene_expr.shape[0])
print("基因数：", gene_expr.shape[1])
print("是否存在重复基因名：", gene_expr.columns.duplicated().any())
print("缺失值数量：", int(gene_expr.isna().sum().sum()))
print("患者编号是否重复：", gene_expr.index.duplicated().any())

print("\n基因表达矩阵预览：")
display(gene_expr.iloc[:5, :8])

# 10. 保存结果
gene_expr_path = (
    processed_dir / "GSE37642_GPL96_gene_expression.csv"
)

gene_expr.to_csv(gene_expr_path, encoding="utf-8-sig")

# 同时保存每个基因选中的代表探针，便于复核
map_path = (
    processed_dir / "GSE37642_GPL96_gene_probe_mapping.csv"
)

gene_map[["Gene Symbol", "ID", "variance"]].to_csv(
    map_path, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig"
)

print("\n基因表达矩阵已保存：", gene_expr_path)
print("基因与代表探针对照表已保存：", map_path)

#检查基因表达变异程度
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# 1. 设置路径
base_dir = Path.home() / "Desktop" / "AML_Prognosis"
processed_dir = base_dir / "data" / "processed"
results_dir = base_dir / "results"
results_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# 2. 读取基因表达矩阵
gene_expr = pd.read_csv(
    processed_dir / "GSE37642_GPL96_gene_expression.csv",
    index_col=0
)

# 3. 计算每个基因在417例患者中的表达方差
gene_variance = gene_expr.var(axis=0).sort_values(ascending=False)

print("患者数：", gene_expr.shape[0])
print("基因数：", gene_expr.shape[1])
print("表达方差最小值：", round(gene_variance.min(), 4))
print("表达方差中位数：", round(gene_variance.median(), 4))
print("表达方差最大值：", round(gene_variance.max(), 4))

print("\n表达方差最高的20个基因：")

    gene_variance.head(20).rename("Expression_variance").to_frame()
)

# 4. 绘制表达方差分布直方图

plt.hist(gene_variance, bins=50, edgecolor="black")
plt.xlabel("Expression variance")
plt.ylabel("Number of genes")
plt.title("Variance distribution of AML gene expression")
plt.tight_layout()

#过滤低变异基因

# 1. 路径设置
base_dir = Path.home() / "Desktop" / "AML_Prognosis"
processed_dir = base_dir / "data" / "processed"
results_dir = base_dir / "results"
results_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# 2. 读取基因表达矩阵
gene_expr = pd.read_csv(
    processed_dir / "GSE37642_GPL96_gene_expression.csv",
    index_col=0
)

# 3. 计算各基因在患者间的表达方差
gene_variance = gene_expr.var(axis=0)

# 4. 以方差第25百分位数作为初步过滤阈值
variance_threshold = gene_variance.quantile(0.25)

selected_genes = gene_variance[
    gene_variance > variance_threshold
].index

filtered_expr = gene_expr[selected_genes].copy()

print("过滤前基因数：", gene_expr.shape[1])
print("方差第25百分位数：", round(variance_threshold, 4))
print("过滤后基因数：", filtered_expr.shape[1])
print("患者数：", filtered_expr.shape[0])
print("过滤后缺失值数量：", int(filtered_expr.isna().sum().sum()))

# 5. 保存过滤后的矩阵
filtered_path = (
    processed_dir / "GSE37642_GPL96_gene_expression_filtered.csv"
)
filtered_expr.to_csv(filtered_path, encoding="utf-8-sig")

# 同时保存每个基因的方差及筛选状态，便于报告复现
variance_table = gene_variance.rename("variance").to_frame()
variance_table["selected"] = variance_table.index.isin(selected_genes)

variance_path = (
    processed_dir / "GSE37642_GPL96_gene_variance_filter.csv"
)
variance_table.to_csv(variance_path, encoding="utf-8-sig")

print("\n过滤后的表达矩阵保存至：", filtered_path)
print("方差筛选记录保存至：", variance_path)

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pathlib import Path

# ============================================================
# 1. 设置项目路径
# ============================================================
base_dir = Path.home() / "Desktop" / "AML_Prognosis"
processed_dir = base_dir / "data" / "processed"
results_dir = base_dir / "results"

results_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

surv_path = processed_dir / "GSE37642_survival_analysis_ready.csv"

# 检查文件是否存在
if not surv_path.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(
        f"未找到生存数据文件：{surv_path}\n"
        "请检查项目路径和文件名是否正确。"
    )

# ============================================================
# 2. 设置绘图字体，尽可能支持中文显示
# ============================================================
plt.rcParams["font.sans-serif"] = [
    "Microsoft YaHei",
    "SimHei",
    "Arial"
]
plt.rcParams["axes.unicode_minus"] = False

# ============================================================
# 3. 读取生存数据并检查基本信息
# ============================================================
surv = pd.read_csv(surv_path)

print("=" * 60)
print("一、数据基本信息")
print("=" * 60)

print("数据集维度：", surv.shape)
print("数据列名：", surv.columns.tolist())
print("\n前 5 行数据：")

display(surv.head())

# 检查必要的数据列
time_col = "overall survival (days)"
status_col = "life status"

required_cols = [time_col, status_col]

missing_cols = [
    col for col in required_cols
    if col not in surv.columns
]

if missing_cols:
    raise ValueError(
        f"数据中缺少必要列：{missing_cols}\n"
        f"当前数据列名为：{surv.columns.tolist()}"
    )

# ============================================================
# 4. 清理生存时间和结局状态
# ============================================================
surv[time_col] = pd.to_numeric(
    surv[time_col],
    errors="coerce"
)

status = (
    surv[status_col]
    .astype("string")
    .str.strip()
    .str.lower()
)

# 根据原始数据的真实编码生成 event：
# 1 = 死亡事件
# 0 = 删失
death_values = {
    "dead", "deceased", "death", "1"
}

censor_values = {
    "alive", "living", "censored", "censor", "0"
}

surv["event"] = np.select(
    [
        status.isin(death_values),
        status.isin(censor_values)
    ],
    [
        1,
        0
    ],
    default=np.nan
)

# ============================================================
# 5. 检查数据质量
# ============================================================
print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("二、数据质量检查")
print("=" * 60)

print("总患者数：", len(surv))

print(
    "生存时间缺失数：",
    surv[time_col].isna().sum()
)

print(
    "结局无法识别数：",
    surv["event"].isna().sum()
)

print(
    "生存时间小于或等于 0 的记录数：",
    (
        surv[time_col].notna()
        & (surv[time_col] <= 0)
    ).sum()
)

print("\n原始结局状态分布：")
display(
    surv[status_col].value_counts(dropna=False).to_frame(
        name="人数"
    )
)

# 仅保留生存时间有效、结局可识别且生存时间大于 0 的记录
valid = surv.loc[
    surv[time_col].notna()
    & surv["event"].notna()
    & (surv[time_col] > 0)
].copy()

valid["event"] = valid["event"].astype(int)

if valid.empty:
    raise ValueError(
        "清理后没有有效患者，请检查生存时间和结局编码。"
    )

print("\n有效患者数：", len(valid))
print("排除的记录数：", len(surv) - len(valid))

# ============================================================
# 6. 描述患者生存时间分布
# ============================================================
print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("三、生存时间描述性统计")
print("=" * 60)

time_summary = valid[time_col].describe()

display(
    time_summary.to_frame(name="生存时间（天）")
)

q1 = valid[time_col].quantile(0.25)
median_time = valid[time_col].median()
q3 = valid[time_col].quantile(0.75)

print(f"平均生存时间：{valid[time_col].mean():.2f} 天")
print(f"生存时间标准差：{valid[time_col].std():.2f} 天")
print(f"生存时间中位数：{median_time:.2f} 天")
print(f"第 25 百分位数：{q1:.2f} 天")
print(f"第 75 百分位数：{q3:.2f} 天")
print(
    f"生存时间范围："
    f"{valid[time_col].min():.0f}–"
    f"{valid[time_col].max():.0f} 天"
)

# ============================================================
# 7. 正确统计死亡事件与删失人数
# ============================================================
print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("四、生存结局分布")
print("=" * 60)

death_count = int((valid["event"] == 1).sum())
censor_count = int((valid["event"] == 0).sum())
total_count = len(valid)

event_summary = pd.DataFrame({
    "结局": [
        "死亡事件",
        "删失（随访结束时未观察到死亡）"
    ],
    "人数": [
        death_count,
        censor_count
    ],
    "比例（%）": [
        round(death_count / total_count * 100, 2),
        round(censor_count / total_count * 100, 2)
    ]
})

display(event_summary)

print("死亡事件编码：event = 1")
print("删失编码：event = 0")
print("有效患者总数：", total_count)

# ============================================================
# 8. 绘制生存时间分布直方图
# ============================================================
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))

plt.hist(
    valid[time_col],
    bins=30,
    edgecolor="black",
    alpha=0.8
)

plt.axvline(
    median_time,
    linestyle="--",
    linewidth=2,
    label=f"原始生存时间中位数 = {median_time:.0f} 天"
)

plt.xlabel("总体生存时间（天）")
plt.ylabel("患者人数")
plt.title("AML 患者总体生存时间分布")
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()

plt.savefig(
    results_dir / "AML_survival_time_distribution.png",
    dpi=300,
    bbox_inches="tight"
)

plt.show()

# ============================================================
# 9. 绘制死亡事件与删失人数柱状图
# ============================================================
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))

bars = plt.bar(
    event_summary["结局"],
    event_summary["人数"],
    edgecolor="black",
    alpha=0.8
)

# 在柱子上标注人数
for bar, count in zip(
    bars,
    event_summary["人数"]
):
    plt.text(
        bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2,
        bar.get_height(),
        f"{count}",
        ha="center",
        va="bottom"
    )

plt.xlabel("生存结局")
plt.ylabel("患者人数")
plt.title("AML 患者生存结局分布")

plt.xticks(rotation=10)
plt.tight_layout()

plt.savefig(
    results_dir / "AML_survival_outcome_distribution.png",
    dpi=300,
    bbox_inches="tight"
)

plt.show()

# ============================================================
# 10. 保存统计结果
# ============================================================
time_summary.to_frame(
    name="Overall survival (days)"
).to_csv(
    results_dir / "AML_survival_time_summary.csv",
    encoding="utf-8-sig"
)

event_summary.to_csv(
    results_dir / "AML_survival_outcome_summary.csv",
    index=False,
    encoding="utf-8-sig"
)

# 保存本步骤实际纳入统计的患者数据
valid.to_csv(
    results_dir / "AML_survival_descriptive_valid_data.csv",
    index=False,
    encoding="utf-8-sig"
)

print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("五、分析完成")
print("=" * 60)

print("结果保存目录：", results_dir)
print("已保存文件：")
print("1. AML_survival_time_summary.csv")
print("2. AML_survival_outcome_summary.csv")
print("3. AML_survival_descriptive_valid_data.csv")
print("4. AML_survival_time_distribution.png")
print("5. AML_survival_outcome_distribution.png")

3.2 绘制 Kaplan–Meier 总体生存曲线¶

In [20]:
from lifelines import KaplanMeierFitter
print("安装成功，可以开始生存分析！")

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pathlib import Path
from lifelines import KaplanMeierFitter
from lifelines.plotting import add_at_risk_counts

# 1. 读取生存数据
base_dir = Path.home() / "Desktop" / "AML_Prognosis"
processed_dir = base_dir / "data" / "processed"
results_dir = base_dir / "results"
results_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

surv = pd.read_csv(
    processed_dir / "GSE37642_model_survival.csv",
    index_col=0
)

time_col = "overall survival (days)"
event_col = "event"

# 2. 再次检查数据
surv[time_col] = pd.to_numeric(surv[time_col], errors="raise")
surv[event_col] = pd.to_numeric(surv[event_col], errors="raise")

assert surv[time_col].notna().all()
assert (surv[time_col] > 0).all()
assert surv[event_col].isin([0, 1]).all()

# 3. 拟合 Kaplan-Meier 曲线
kmf = KaplanMeierFitter()
kmf.fit(
    durations=surv[time_col],
    event_observed=surv[event_col],
    label="Overall survival"
)

# 4. 绘图
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 6))

kmf.plot_survival_function(
    ax=ax,
    ci_show=True,
    show_censors=True
)

add_at_risk_counts(kmf, ax=ax)

ax.set_title("Overall Survival of the AML Cohort")
ax.set_xlabel("Time (days)")
ax.set_ylabel("Survival probability")
ax.set_ylim(0, 1.05)
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.25)

plt.tight_layout()

# 5. 保存图片
figure_path = results_dir / "AML_overall_KM_curve.png"
plt.savefig(figure_path, dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()

# 6. 输出中位生存时间
print("中位生存时间（天）：", kmf.median_survival_time_)
print("KM 曲线图保存至：", figure_path)

安装成功，可以开始生存分析！

中位生存时间（天）： 329.0
KM 曲线图保存至： C:\Users\[用户名]\Desktop\AML_Prognosis\results\AML_overall_KM_curve.png

本研究基于 GEO 数据库中的 GSE37642 数据集，选取 GPL96 平台的急性髓系白血病（AML）患者样本开展总体生存分析。经过表达矩阵清洗、生存信息整理及样本匹配后，共纳入 417 例具有有效生存时间和结局信息的患者。其中，观察到 308 例死亡事件，109 例患者在末次随访时仍存活并作为删失数据处理。 采用 Kaplan–Meier 方法估计患者的总体生存函数，所得中位总体生存时间为 329 天。该结果描述了本研究队列的总体生存情况，为后续预后相关特征筛选和生存预测模型构建提供了基础。

3.3 GPL96芯片基因表达特征的描述性统计¶

In [21]:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pathlib import Path

# ============================================================
# 1. 设置项目路径
# ============================================================
base_dir = Path.home() / "Desktop" / "AML_Prognosis"
processed_dir = base_dir / "data" / "processed"
results_dir = base_dir / "results"

results_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

expr_path = processed_dir / "GSE37642_GPL96_gene_expression.csv"

if not expr_path.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(
        f"未找到基因表达矩阵：{expr_path}\n"
        "请确认前面的基因水平表达矩阵生成步骤已经运行。"
    )

# ============================================================
# 2. 设置绘图字体
# ============================================================
plt.rcParams["font.sans-serif"] = [
    "Microsoft YaHei", "SimHei", "Arial"
]
plt.rcParams["axes.unicode_minus"] = False

# ============================================================
# 3. 读取基因水平表达矩阵
#    预期格式：行 = 患者，列 = 基因
# ============================================================
expr = pd.read_csv(expr_path, index_col=0)

print("=" * 60)
print("一、基因表达矩阵基本信息")
print("=" * 60)

print("矩阵维度（患者数 × 基因数）：", expr.shape)
print("患者数：", expr.shape[0])
print("基因数：", expr.shape[1])
print("患者编号是否重复：", expr.index.duplicated().any())
print("基因名称是否重复：", expr.columns.duplicated().any())

print("\n前 5 行、前 5 列：")
display(expr.iloc[:5, :5])

# 将表达值转换为数值类型；无法转换的内容设为缺失值
expr = expr.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce")

# 检查缺失值和无穷值
expr = expr.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

print("\n缺失表达值数量：", int(expr.isna().sum().sum()))
print("无穷值处理后是否仍存在无穷值：",
      np.isinf(expr.to_numpy(dtype=float)).any())

# 删除全为缺失值的基因
all_missing_genes = expr.columns[expr.isna().all()].tolist()

if all_missing_genes:
    print("删除全为缺失值的基因数：", len(all_missing_genes))
    expr = expr.drop(columns=all_missing_genes)

# 如果有零星缺失值，提示并在计算描述性统计时忽略缺失值
remaining_missing = int(expr.isna().sum().sum())
print("剩余缺失表达值数量：", remaining_missing)

if expr.empty or expr.shape[1] == 0:
    raise ValueError("表达矩阵为空，请检查输入文件。")

# ============================================================
# 4. 计算整体表达值的描述性统计
# ============================================================
print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("二、整体基因表达值分布")
print("=" * 60)

all_values = expr.to_numpy(dtype=float).ravel()
all_values = all_values[np.isfinite(all_values)]

overall_summary = pd.Series(all_values).describe(
    percentiles=[0.25, 0.50, 0.75]
)

overall_summary.index = [
    "有效表达值数量" if x == "count" else
    "均值" if x == "mean" else
    "标准差" if x == "std" else
    "最小值" if x == "min" else
    "25%分位数" if x == "25%" else
    "中位数" if x == "50%" else
    "75%分位数" if x == "75%" else
    "最大值" if x == "max" else x
    for x in overall_summary.index
]

display(overall_summary.to_frame(name="统计结果"))

overall_summary.to_csv(
    results_dir / "GPL96_overall_expression_summary.csv",
    encoding="utf-8-sig"
)

# ============================================================
# 5. 绘制整体表达值分布直方图
# ============================================================
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))

plt.hist(
    all_values,
    bins=60,
    edgecolor="black",
    alpha=0.8
)

plt.xlabel("基因表达值")
plt.ylabel("表达值数量")
plt.title("GPL96 基因表达值总体分布")
plt.tight_layout()

plt.savefig(
    results_dir / "GPL96_overall_expression_distribution.png",
    dpi=300,
    bbox_inches="tight"
)

plt.show()

# ============================================================
# 6. 计算每个基因在患者之间的表达统计量
# ============================================================
print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("三、每个基因的表达特征")
print("=" * 60)

gene_summary = pd.DataFrame(index=expr.columns)

gene_summary["mean"] = expr.mean(axis=0)
gene_summary["std"] = expr.std(axis=0)
gene_summary["median"] = expr.median(axis=0)
gene_summary["min"] = expr.min(axis=0)
gene_summary["max"] = expr.max(axis=0)
gene_summary["variance"] = expr.var(axis=0)

# 变异系数：标准差 / 均值
# 当均值为 0 时，变异系数设为 NaN，避免除以 0
gene_summary["cv"] = (
    gene_summary["std"] /
    gene_summary["mean"].where(gene_summary["mean"] != 0)
)

gene_summary.index.name = "Gene"

print("基因统计结果维度：", gene_summary.shape)
print("\n表达方差最高的 10 个基因：")

display(
    gene_summary
    .sort_values("variance", ascending=False)
    .head(10)
)

gene_summary.to_csv(
    results_dir / "GPL96_gene_expression_descriptive_statistics.csv",
    encoding="utf-8-sig"
)

# ============================================================
# 7. 绘制基因表达方差分布
# ============================================================
valid_variance = gene_summary["variance"].dropna()

plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))

plt.hist(
    valid_variance,
    bins=60,
    edgecolor="black",
    alpha=0.8
)

plt.xlabel("基因表达方差")
plt.ylabel("基因数量")
plt.title("GPL96 基因表达方差分布")
plt.tight_layout()

plt.savefig(
    results_dir / "GPL96_gene_variance_distribution.png",
    dpi=300,
    bbox_inches="tight"
)

plt.show()

# ============================================================
# 8. 展示表达方差最高的 20 个基因
# ============================================================
top20_variance = (
    gene_summary["variance"]
    .dropna()
    .sort_values(ascending=False)
    .head(20)
    .sort_values(ascending=True)
)

plt.figure(figsize=(9, 7))

plt.barh(
    top20_variance.index.astype(str),

    results_dir / "GPL96_top20_variable_genes.png",
    dpi=300,
    bbox_inches="tight"
)

plt.show()

# ============================================================
# 9. 计算每位患者的整体表达特征
# ============================================================
sample_summary = pd.DataFrame(index=expr.index)

sample_summary["mean_expression"] = expr.mean(axis=1)
sample_summary["median_expression"] = expr.median(axis=1)
sample_summary["std_expression"] = expr.std(axis=1)
sample_summary["missing_gene_count"] = expr.isna().sum(axis=1)

sample_summary.index.name = "Sample"

print("\n" + "=" * 60)

print("=" * 60)

display(sample_summary.describe().T)

4. 预测模型建立¶

4.1 训练集与测试集划分¶

In [22]:
#模型建立阶段，划分训练集与测试集
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

# 1. 设置路径
base_dir = Path.home() / "Desktop" / "AML_Prognosis"
processed_dir = base_dir / "data" / "processed"
results_dir = base_dir / "results"
results_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# 2. 重新读取数据
expr = pd.read_csv(
    processed_dir / "GSE37642_GPL96_gene_expression_filtered.csv",
    index_col=0
)

surv = pd.read_csv(
    processed_dir / "GSE37642_model_survival.csv",
    index_col=0
)

# 3. 将患者编号转换成普通字符串列表
expr.index = expr.index.astype(str)
surv.index = surv.index.astype(str)

assert expr.index.equals(surv.index), "表达矩阵与生存数据的患者顺序不一致"

duration_col = "overall survival (days)"
event_col = "event"

assert (surv[duration_col] > 0).all(), "存在非正的生存时间"
assert surv[event_col].isin([0, 1]).all(), "event 列不是 0/1 编码"

patient_ids = expr.index.tolist()
event_labels = surv.loc[patient_ids, event_col].astype(int).tolist()

# 4. 划分训练集和测试集
train_ids, test_ids = train_test_split(
    patient_ids,
    test_size=0.30,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=event_labels
)

# 5. 提取训练集和测试集
X_train_all = expr.loc[train_ids].copy()
X_test_all = expr.loc[test_ids].copy()

y_train = surv.loc[train_ids, [duration_col, event_col]].copy()
y_test = surv.loc[test_ids, [duration_col, event_col]].copy()

# 6. 只根据训练集表达方差选择前500个候选基因
train_variance = X_train_all.var(axis=0)
top_n = min(500, X_train_all.shape[1])
candidate_genes = train_variance.nlargest(top_n).index.tolist()

X_train = X_train_all[candidate_genes].copy()
X_test = X_test_all[candidate_genes].copy()

# 7. 检查结果
print("训练集患者数：", len(train_ids))
print("测试集患者数：", len(test_ids))
print("训练集死亡事件数：", int(y_train[event_col].sum()))
print("训练集删失数：", int((y_train[event_col] == 0).sum()))
print("测试集死亡事件数：", int(y_test[event_col].sum()))
print("测试集删失数：", int((y_test[event_col] == 0).sum()))
print("候选基因数：", len(candidate_genes))
print("训练集缺失值数：", int(X_train.isna().sum().sum()))
print("测试集缺失值数：", int(X_test.isna().sum().sum()))

# 8. 保存划分信息
split_table = pd.DataFrame({
    "SAMPLE": train_ids + test_ids,
    "dataset": ["train"] * len(train_ids) + ["test"] * len(test_ids)
})
split_table.to_csv(
    processed_dir / "GSE37642_train_test_split.csv",
    index=False,
    encoding="utf-8-sig"
)

pd.Series(candidate_genes, name="gene").to_csv(
    processed_dir / "GSE37642_candidate_500_genes.csv",
    index=False,
    encoding="utf-8-sig"
)

print("\n训练集/测试集划分信息和候选基因名单已保存。")

4.2 候选基因表达数据标准化¶

In [23]:
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

# 1. 检查 4.1 节是否已经成功运行
required_variables = [
    "X_train", "X_test",
    "y_train", "y_test",
    "candidate_genes"
]

missing_variables = [
    name for name in required_variables
    if name not in globals()
]

if missing_variables:
    raise NameError(
        f"请先成功运行 4.1 节，缺少变量：{missing_variables}"
    )

# 2. 检查表达数据
if X_train.shape[1] == 0 or X_test.shape[1] == 0:
    raise ValueError("训练集或测试集没有可用基因。")

if X_train.isna().any().any() or X_test.isna().any().any():
    raise ValueError("表达矩阵存在缺失值，请先处理。")

if not np.isfinite(X_train.to_numpy(dtype=float)).all():
    raise ValueError("训练集存在无穷值。")

if not np.isfinite(X_test.to_numpy(dtype=float)).all():
    raise ValueError("测试集存在无穷值。")

# 3. 使用训练集拟合标准化参数
scaler = StandardScaler()

X_train_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_train)
X_test_scaled = scaler.transform(X_test)

# 4. 转回 DataFrame，保留患者编号和基因名称
X_train_scaled = pd.DataFrame(
    X_train_scaled,
    index=X_train.index,
    columns=X_train.columns
)

X_test_scaled = pd.DataFrame(
    X_test_scaled,
    index=X_test.index,
    columns=X_test.columns
)

# 5. 检查标准化结果
print("========== 数据标准化结果 ==========")
print("训练集维度：", X_train_scaled.shape)
print("测试集维度：", X_test_scaled.shape)

print(
    "训练集标准化后平均值（前5个基因）："
)
print(X_train_scaled.mean(axis=0).head())

print(
    "\n训练集标准化后标准差（前5个基因）："
)
print(X_train_scaled.std(axis=0, ddof=0).head())

print("\n训练集缺失值数量：",
      int(X_train_scaled.isna().sum().sum()))
print("测试集缺失值数量：",
      int(X_test_scaled.isna().sum().sum()))

# 6. 保存标准化后的表达矩阵
base_dir = Path.home() / "Desktop" / "AML_Prognosis"
processed_dir = base_dir / "data" / "processed"
processed_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

train_path = (
    processed_dir / "GSE37642_X_train_scaled.csv"
)
test_path = (
    processed_dir / "GSE37642_X_test_scaled.csv"
)

X_train_scaled.to_csv(train_path, encoding="utf-8-sig")
X_test_scaled.to_csv(test_path, encoding="utf-8-sig")

print("\n标准化后的训练集已保存：", train_path)
print("标准化后的测试集已保存：", test_path)

4.3 拟合 LASSO-Cox 生存模型¶

In [24]:
# 拟合 LASSO-Cox 生存模型
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from lifelines import CoxPHFitter

# 1. 设置路径
base_dir = Path.home() / "Desktop" / "AML_Prognosis"
processed_dir = base_dir / "data" / "processed"
results_dir = base_dir / "results"
results_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# 2. 标准化：只使用训练集计算均值和标准差
scaler = StandardScaler()

X_train_scaled = pd.DataFrame(
    scaler.fit_transform(X_train),
    index=X_train.index,
    columns=X_train.columns
)

X_test_scaled = pd.DataFrame(
    scaler.transform(X_test),
    index=X_test.index,
    columns=X_test.columns
)

# 3. 构建 Cox 模型所需的数据
duration_col = "overall survival (days)"
event_col = "event"

train_model_data = X_train_scaled.copy()
train_model_data[duration_col] = y_train[duration_col].astype(float)
train_model_data[event_col] = y_train[event_col].astype(int)

# 4. 拟合 LASSO-Cox 初始模型
# 保留原有参数，不调整惩罚强度
cph = CoxPHFitter(penalizer=0.1, l1_ratio=1.0)

cph.fit(
    train_model_data,
    duration_col=duration_col,
    event_col=event_col,
    show_progress=True
)

# 5. 查看拟合结果
coef = cph.params_.copy()

selected_coef = coef[coef.abs() > 1e-6].sort_values(
    key=lambda x: x.abs(),
    ascending=False
)

print("\n模型拟合完成。")
print("候选基因数：", X_train.shape[1])
print("非零系数基因数：", len(selected_coef))
print("\n绝对系数最大的前20个基因：")
display(selected_coef.head(20).to_frame("coefficient"))

# 6. 保存系数表
coef_table = coef.rename("coefficient").to_frame()
coef_table["abs_coefficient"] = coef_table["coefficient"].abs()
coef_table["selected"] = coef_table["abs_coefficient"] > 1e-6
coef_table = coef_table.sort_values("abs_coefficient", ascending=False)

coef_path = results_dir / "AML_LASSO_Cox_initial_coefficients.csv"
coef_table.to_csv(coef_path, encoding="utf-8-sig")

print("\n系数表保存至：", coef_path)

# 7. 计算训练集和测试集风险评分
# 使用同一个已经拟合好的 cph 模型，不重新拟合
train_risk = cph.predict_partial_hazard(X_train_scaled).iloc[:, 0] \
    if isinstance(cph.predict_partial_hazard(X_train_scaled), pd.DataFrame) \
    else cph.predict_partial_hazard(X_train_scaled)

test_risk = cph.predict_partial_hazard(X_test_scaled).iloc[:, 0] \
    if isinstance(cph.predict_partial_hazard(X_test_scaled), pd.DataFrame) \
    else cph.predict_partial_hazard(X_test_scaled)

train_risk = pd.Series(
    np.asarray(train_risk).reshape(-1),
    index=X_train_scaled.index,
    name="risk_score"
)

test_risk = pd.Series(
    np.asarray(test_risk).reshape(-1),
    index=X_test_scaled.index,
    name="risk_score"
)

# 8. 建立测试集预测结果，供原有 KM 曲线代码直接使用
test_result = pd.DataFrame(index=X_test_scaled.index)

test_result["risk_score"] = test_risk
test_result["OS_days"] = y_test.loc[
    test_result.index, duration_col
].astype(float)

test_result["event"] = y_test.loc[
    test_result.index, event_col
].astype(int)

print("\n风险评分已生成。")
print("训练集风险评分人数：", len(train_risk))
print("测试集风险评分人数：", len(test_result))
print("测试集预测结果列名：", test_result.columns.tolist())

print("\n训练集风险评分预览：")
display(train_risk.head())

print("\n测试集预测结果预览：")
display(test_result.head())

5.预测模型评估与可视化¶

5.1 计算训练集与测试集 C-index¶

In [25]:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pathlib import Path
from lifelines.utils import concordance_index

# 1. 设置输出路径
base_dir = Path.home() / "Desktop" / "AML_Prognosis"
results_dir = base_dir / "results"
results_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

duration_col = "overall survival (days)"
event_col = "event"

# 2. 预测风险评分
# predict_partial_hazard 返回一维 Series，不需要使用 iloc[:, 0]
train_risk = cph.predict_partial_hazard(X_train_scaled)
test_risk = cph.predict_partial_hazard(X_test_scaled)

# 3. 计算训练集和测试集 C-index
# 风险越高，预期生存时间越短，因此使用负风险评分
train_cindex = concordance_index(
    y_train[duration_col],
    -train_risk,
    y_train[event_col]
)

test_cindex = concordance_index(
    y_test[duration_col],
    -test_risk,
    y_test[event_col]
)

print("训练集 C-index：", round(train_cindex, 4))
print("测试集 C-index：", round(test_cindex, 4))

# 4. 生成测试集风险评分表
test_result = pd.DataFrame({
    "SAMPLE": test_risk.index.astype(str),
    "OS_days": y_test.loc[test_risk.index, duration_col].to_numpy(),
    "event": y_test.loc[test_risk.index, event_col].to_numpy(),
    "risk_score": test_risk.to_numpy()
})

# 按测试集风险评分中位数划分高低风险组
risk_median = test_result["risk_score"].median()
test_result["risk_group"] = np.where(
    test_result["risk_score"] >= risk_median,
    "High risk",
    "Low risk"
)

# 5. 保存结果
result_path = results_dir / "AML_LASSO_Cox_test_predictions.csv"
test_result.to_csv(result_path, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")

print("\n测试集风险评分中位数：", round(risk_median, 6))
print("测试集高风险组人数：", int((test_result["risk_group"] == "High risk").sum()))
print("测试集低风险组人数：", int((test_result["risk_group"] == "Low risk").sum()))
print("预测结果保存至：", result_path)

display(test_result.head())

5.2 高低风险分组、KM 生存曲线与 Log-rank 检验¶

In [26]:
#评价模型测试集预测效果，计算训练集和测试集的 C-index，并在测试集绘制高、低风险组的 Kaplan–Meier 生存曲线
from lifelines import KaplanMeierFitter
from lifelines.statistics import logrank_test

# 1. 设置结果保存路径
base_dir = Path.home() / "Desktop" / "AML_Prognosis"
results_dir = base_dir / "results"
results_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# 2. 使用训练集风险评分的中位数作为分组阈值
train_risk_median = float(train_risk.median())

test_result["risk_group"] = np.where(
    test_result["risk_score"] >= train_risk_median,
    "High risk",
    "Low risk"
)

print("训练集风险评分中位数（分组阈值）：", round(train_risk_median, 6))
print("\n测试集风险分组人数：")
print(test_result["risk_group"].value_counts())

# 3. 分别提取高、低风险组
high = test_result[test_result["risk_group"] == "High risk"]
low = test_result[test_result["risk_group"] == "Low risk"]

print("\n高风险组死亡事件数：", int(high["event"].sum()))
print("低风险组死亡事件数：", int(low["event"].sum()))

# 4. 绘制 Kaplan-Meier 生存曲线
kmf = KaplanMeierFitter()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 6))

for group_name, group_data in [
    ("High risk", high),
    ("Low risk", low)
]:
    kmf.fit(
        durations=group_data["OS_days"],
        event_observed=group_data["event"],
        label=group_name
    )
    kmf.plot_survival_function(
        ax=ax,
        ci_show=True,
        show_censors=True
    )

ax.set_title("Overall Survival by Predicted Risk Group")
ax.set_xlabel("Overall survival (days)")
ax.set_ylabel("Survival probability")
ax.set_ylim(0, 1.05)
ax.grid(alpha=0.25)
ax.legend()
plt.tight_layout()

km_path = results_dir / "AML_test_risk_group_KM.png"
plt.savefig(km_path, dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()

# 5. Log-rank 检验：比较两组生存曲线
logrank_result = logrank_test(
    high["OS_days"],
    low["OS_days"],
    event_observed_A=high["event"],
    event_observed_B=low["event"]
)

print("\nLog-rank 检验统计量：", round(logrank_result.test_statistic, 4))
print("Log-rank 检验 P 值：", f"{logrank_result.p_value:.6g}")

# 6. 保存更新后的测试集预测结果
prediction_path = results_dir / "AML_LASSO_Cox_test_predictions.csv"
test_result.to_csv(
    prediction_path,
    index=False,
    encoding="utf-8-sig"
)

print("\n生存曲线保存位置：", km_path)
print("更新后的测试集预测结果：", prediction_path)

#模型调整，增强正则化，检查模型稳定性
import warnings
from lifelines import CoxPHFitter

# 保留原模型 cph，不覆盖它
# 使用更强的 L1 惩罚，观察系数是否更加稀疏、拟合是否稳定
cph_stronger_penalty = CoxPHFitter(
    penalizer=0.5,
    l1_ratio=1.0
)

with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught_warnings:
    warnings.simplefilter("always")

    cph_stronger_penalty.fit(
        train_model_data,
        duration_col="overall survival (days)",
        event_col="event",
        show_progress=True
    )

# 检查拟合结果
coef_new = cph_stronger_penalty.params_.astype(float)

print("\n候选模型是否已拟合：",
      getattr(cph_stronger_penalty, "_model", None) is not None)
print("系数总数：", len(coef_new))
print("系数是否存在缺失值：", coef_new.isna().any())
print("最大绝对系数：", round(coef_new.abs().max(), 8))
print("绝对系数 > 1e-5 的基因数：",
      int((coef_new.abs() > 1e-5).sum()))
print("绝对系数 > 1e-4 的基因数：",
      int((coef_new.abs() > 1e-4).sum()))

print("\n拟合过程中记录到的警告数量：", len(caught_warnings))
for w in caught_warnings[:5]:
    print(type(w.message).__name__, ":", str(w.message)[:250])

print("\n候选模型绝对系数最大的前 10 个基因：")
display(
    coef_new.abs()
    .sort_values(ascending=False)
    .head(10)
    .rename("abs_coefficient")
    .to_frame()
)

#保存当前模型的关键结果

base_dir = Path.home() / "Desktop" / "AML_Prognosis"
results_dir = base_dir / "results"
results_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# 保存原模型的全部系数
coef = cph.params_.astype(float).rename("coefficient").to_frame()
coef.index.name = "gene"
coef["abs_coefficient"] = coef["coefficient"].abs()

coef_path = results_dir / "AML_LASSO_Cox_all_coefficients.csv"
coef.to_csv(coef_path, encoding="utf-8-sig")

# 使用绝对系数 > 1e-5 作为本次描述性汇总阈值
selected = coef[coef["abs_coefficient"] > 1e-5].copy()
selected = selected.sort_values("abs_coefficient", ascending=False)

selected_path = results_dir / "AML_LASSO_Cox_selected_genes_threshold_1e-5.csv"
selected.to_csv(selected_path, encoding="utf-8-sig")

print("原模型系数已保存：", coef_path)

print("基因汇总已保存：", selected_path)
display(selected.head(10))

#重新确认测试集 C-index
from lifelines.utils import concordance_index

train_risk_check = cph.predict_partial_hazard(X_train_scaled)
test_risk_check = cph.predict_partial_hazard(X_test_scaled)

train_cindex_check = concordance_index(
    y_train["overall survival (days)"],
    -train_risk_check,
    y_train["event"]
)

test_cindex_check = concordance_index(
    y_test["overall survival (days)"],
    -test_risk_check,
    y_test["event"]
)

print("训练集 C-index：", round(train_cindex_check, 4))
print("测试集 C-index：", round(test_cindex_check, 4))

#绘制模型性能对比图
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
# 设置结果保存路径
base_dir = Path.home() / "Desktop" / "AML_Prognosis"
results_dir = base_dir / "results"
results_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# 使用已经得到的真实结果
labels = ["Training set", "Test set"]
scores = [0.6776, 0.5860]

# 绘制柱状图
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 5))

bars = ax.bar(labels, scores, width=0.55)

# 添加数值标签
for bar, score in zip(bars, scores):
    ax.text(
        bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2,
        score + 0.015,
        f"{score:.4f}",
        ha="center",
        va="bottom",
        fontsize=11
    )

ax.axhline(
    0.5,
    linestyle="--",
    linewidth=1,
    label="C-index = 0.5"
)

ax.set_ylim(0, 0.8)
ax.set_ylabel("Concordance index (C-index)")
ax.set_title("Performance of the LASSO-Cox Model")
ax.legend()
plt.tight_layout()

# 保存高分辨率图片
fig_path = results_dir / "AML_LASSO_Cox_Cindex_comparison.png"
plt.savefig(fig_path, dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()

print("图像已保存至：", fig_path)

from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

# 1. 项目文件夹
base_dir = Path.home() / "Desktop" / "AML_Prognosis"

# 2. 检查主要文件夹
folders = {
    "raw": base_dir / "data" / "raw",
    "processed": base_dir / "data" / "processed",
    "results": base_dir / "results",
}

for name, folder in folders.items():
    print(f"\n{'=' * 20} {name} {'=' * 20}")

    if not folder.exists():
        print("文件夹不存在：", folder)
        continue

    files = sorted(p for p in folder.iterdir() if p.is_file())

    if not files:
        print("该文件夹目前没有文件")
        continue

    for file in files:
        size_mb = file.stat().st_size / (1024 * 1024)
        print(f"{file.name}  |  {size_mb:.2f} MB")

from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

# 项目路径
base_dir = Path.home() / "Desktop" / "AML_Prognosis"
results_dir = base_dir / "results"

# 检查以下结果表
files_to_check = [
    "AML_LASSO_Cox_selected_genes_threshold_1e-5.csv",
    "AML_LASSO_Cox_all_coefficients.csv",
    "AML_univariate_cox_training_results.csv",
    "AML_survival_outcome_summary.csv",
    "AML_survival_time_summary.csv",
]

for filename in files_to_check:
    file_path = results_dir / filename

    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print(f"文件：{filename}")

    if not file_path.exists():
        print("文件不存在")
        continue

    try:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path, encoding="utf-8-sig")

        print("数据维度：", df.shape)
        print("列名：", df.columns.tolist())
        print("\n前 5 行：")
        print(df.head().to_string(index=False))

    except Exception as e:
        print("读取失败：", repr(e))
